text: 【李强：纵深开展“人工智能+制造”行动 因地制宜培育壮大先进制造业集群】全国先进制造业大会9月16日至17日在京召开。会上传达了习近平重要指示。中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理李强出席会议并讲话。李强指出，要聚焦重点领域综合施策、精准发力，不断提升先进制造业的创新力、竞争力、综合实力。打造产业创新驱动引擎，筑牢基础研究支撑，强化关键核心技术攻关，深化科技成果转化应用。加快新兴产业规模应用，加强未来产业前瞻布局，推动传统产业焕新升级。纵深开展“人工智能+制造”行动，加大对企业数智化转型引导支持力度，夯实智能软硬件基础。推动先进制造业和现代服务业深度融合，创新发展服务型制造。因地制宜培育壮大先进制造业集群，分类分层推动提质升级。持续深化改革开放，强化企业主体地位，加强政策和要素供给，营造良好发展环境，不断增强先进制造
text_en: [Li Qiang: Carry out the "AI + Manufacturing" initiative in depth and cultivate and strengthen advanced manufacturing clusters according to local conditions] The National Advanced Manufacturing Conference was held in Beijing from September 16 to 17. Xi Jinping's important instructions were conveyed at the meeting. Li Qiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, attended the meeting and delivered a speech. Li Qiang pointed out that it is necessary to focus on key areas, apply comprehensive measures, and target efforts precisely to continuously enhance the innovation capability, competitiveness, and overall strength of advanced manufacturing. Build an industrial innovation-driven engine, solidify basic research support, strengthen breakthroughs in key core technologies, and deepen the application of scientific and technological achievements. Accelerate the large-scale application of emerging industries, strengthen forward-looking布局 for future industries, and promote the renewal and upgrading of traditional industries. Carry out the "AI + Manufacturing" initiative in depth, increase guidance and support for enterprises' digital and intelligent transformation, and consolidate the foundation of intelligent software and hardware. Promote the deep integration of advanced manufacturing and modern services, and innovatively develop service-oriented manufacturing. Cultivate and strengthen advanced manufacturing clusters according to local conditions, and promote quality improvement and upgrading through classification and tiered approaches. Continue to deepen reform and opening up, strengthen the principal position of enterprises, enhance policy and factor supply, create a favorable development environment, and continuously strengthen advanced manufacturing
